<h1 id="pillow---图像处理的瑞士军刀">pillow - 图像处理的瑞士军刀</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是pillow">一、什么是pillow？</h2>
<p><strong>pillow</strong> 是一个用于图像处理的 Python 库。<br>
它是 PIL（Python Imaging Library）的分支，提供了更友好的安装和兼容性。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>打开、操作和保存多种图像格式（如 JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF）</li>
<li>进行基本的图像操作：裁剪、旋转、调整大小等</li>
<li>图像增强：调整亮度、对比度、锐度</li>
<li>图像滤镜：模糊、锐化、边缘检测</li>
<li>像素级操作和图像合并、绘制文本</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>pillow</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web 应用</strong>: 动态生成缩略图、水印图像、验证码图片。</li>
<li><strong>数据科学与机器学习</strong>: 图像数据集预处理，如尺寸统一、数据增强。</li>
<li><strong>桌面应用</strong>: 开发简单的图片查看器、编辑器。</li>
<li><strong>自动化脚本</strong>: 批量处理图片，如转换格式、添加统一标志。</li>
<li><strong>图像分析</strong>: 提取图像特征，进行简单的计算机视觉任务。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install pillow

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install pillow -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>创建一个空白图像，并在特定条件下绘制文本</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# 定义图像的宽度和高度
width = 300
height = 150
# 定义背景颜色和文本颜色
background_color = (255, 255, 255)  # 白色
text_color = (0, 0, 0)  # 黑色

# 创建一个空白的RGB图像
img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), background_color)
# 获取一个可以在图像上绘制的对象
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# 尝试加载字体，如果加载失败则使用默认字体
try:
    # 加载系统字体，注意路径可能需要根据操作系统调整
    font_path = "arial.ttf"  # Windows
    # font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf" # Linux
    # font_path = "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf" # macOS
    font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 20)
except IOError:
    # 如果字体文件不存在或加载失败，则使用Pillow的默认字体
    print(f"警告：无法加载字体 '{font_path}', 使用默认字体。")
    font = ImageFont.load_default()

# 示例条件：如果图像宽度大于高度，则绘制特定文本
if width &gt; height:
    message = "Hello, Pillow!"
    # 计算文本起始位置，使其居中
    text_width, text_height = draw.textsize(message, font=font)
    x = (width - text_width) / 2
    y = (height - text_height) / 2
    draw.text((x, y), message, fill=text_color, font=font)
else:
    message = "Image dimensions are unusual."
    text_width, text_height = draw.textsize(message, font=font)
    x = (width - text_width) / 2
    y = (height - text_height) / 2
    draw.text((x, y), message, fill=text_color, font=font)


# 保存图像
output_filename = "pillow_example.png"
img.save(output_filename)
print(f"图像已保存为 {output_filename}")

# 可选：显示图像（通常在本地调试时使用）
# img.show()
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20PIL%20import%20Image%2C%20ImageDraw%2C%20ImageFont%0A%0A%23%20%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%E7%9A%84%E5%AE%BD%E5%BA%A6%E5%92%8C%E9%AB%98%E5%BA%A6%0Awidth%20%3D%20300%0Aheight%20%3D%20150%0A%23%20%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%E8%83%8C%E6%99%AF%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%E5%92%8C%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E9%A2%9C%E8%89%B2%0Abackground_color%20%3D%20%28255%2C%20255%2C%20255%29%20%20%23%20%E7%99%BD%E8%89%B2%0Atext_color%20%3D%20%280%2C%200%2C%200%29%20%20%23%20%E9%BB%91%E8%89%B2%0A%0A%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E7%A9%BA%E7%99%BD%E7%9A%84RGB%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%0Aimg%20%3D%20Image.new%28'RGB'%2C%20%28width%2C%20height%29%2C%20background_color%29%0A%23%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E5%9C%A8%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%E4%B8%8A%E7%BB%98%E5%88%B6%E7%9A%84%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%0Adraw%20%3D%20ImageDraw.Draw%28img%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%EF%BC%8C%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%E5%88%99%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%0Atry%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%EF%BC%8C%E6%B3%A8%E6%84%8F%E8%B7%AF%E5%BE%84%E5%8F%AF%E8%83%BD%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E6%A0%B9%E6%8D%AE%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E8%B0%83%E6%95%B4%0A%20%20%20%20font_path%20%3D%20%22arial.ttf%22%20%20%23%20Windows%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20font_path%20%3D%20%22%2Fusr%2Fshare%2Ffonts%2Ftruetype%2Fdejavu%2FDejaVuSans-Bold.ttf%22%20%23%20Linux%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20font_path%20%3D%20%22%2FSystem%2FLibrary%2FFonts%2FSupplemental%2FArial%20Bold.ttf%22%20%23%20macOS%0A%20%20%20%20font%20%3D%20ImageFont.truetype%28font_path%2C%2020%29%0Aexcept%20IOError%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%8D%E5%AD%98%E5%9C%A8%E6%88%96%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%88%99%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8Pillow%E7%9A%84%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E8%AD%A6%E5%91%8A%EF%BC%9A%E6%97%A0%E6%B3%95%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%20'%7Bfont_path%7D'%2C%20%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%E3%80%82%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20font%20%3D%20ImageFont.load_default%28%29%0A%0A%23%20%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6%EF%BC%9A%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%E5%AE%BD%E5%BA%A6%E5%A4%A7%E4%BA%8E%E9%AB%98%E5%BA%A6%EF%BC%8C%E5%88%99%E7%BB%98%E5%88%B6%E7%89%B9%E5%AE%9A%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%0Aif%20width%20%3E%20height%3A%0A%20%20%20%20message%20%3D%20%22Hello%2C%20Pillow!%22%0Aelse%3A%0A%20%20%20%20message%20%3D%20%22Image%20dimensions%20are%20unusual.%22%0A%0A%23%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E5%A4%A7%E5%B0%8F%EF%BC%88%E5%85%BC%E5%AE%B9%E6%96%B0%E7%89%88Pillow%EF%BC%89%0Abbox%20%3D%20draw.textbbox%28%280%2C%200%29%2C%20message%2C%20font%3Dfont%29%0Atext_width%20%3D%20bbox%5B2%5D%20-%20bbox%5B0%5D%0Atext_height%20%3D%20bbox%5B3%5D%20-%20bbox%5B1%5D%0Ax%20%3D%20%28width%20-%20text_width%29%20%2F%202%0Ay%20%3D%20%28height%20-%20text_height%29%20%2F%202%0Adraw.text%28%28x%2C%20y%29%2C%20message%2C%20fill%3Dtext_color%2C%20font%3Dfont%29%0A%0A%23%20%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%0Aoutput_filename%20%3D%20%22pillow_example.png%22%0Aimg.save%28output_filename%29%0Aprint%28f%22%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%E5%B7%B2%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E4%B8%BA%20%7Boutput_filename%7D%22%29%0A%23%20img.show%28%29" <p>使用 <a href="https://www.mermaid-online-editor.com/zh?code=flowchart%20TB%0A%20%20A%5B%22%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B%22%5D%20--%3E%20B%7B%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E7%A9%BA%E7%99%BD%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%22%7D%0A%20%20B%20--%3E%20C%5B%22%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E7%BB%98%E5%9B%BE%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%22%5D%0A%20%20C%20--%3E%20D%7B%22%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%22%7D%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20E%5B%22%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E7%9A%84%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%22%5D%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20F%5B%22%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%22%5D%0A%20%20E%20--%3E%20G%7B%22%E5%AE%BD%E5%BA%A6%E5%A4%A7%E4%BA%8E%E9%AB%98%E5%BA%A6%E5%90%97%22%7D%0A%20%20F%20--%3E%20G%0A%20%20G%20--%3E%7C%22%E6%98%AF%22%7C%20H%5B%22%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%20Hello%2CPillow!%22%5D%0A%20%20G%20--%3E%7C%22%E5%90%A6%22%7C%20I%5B%22%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%20Image%20dimensions%20are%20unusual.%22%5D%0A%20%20H%20--%3E%20J%5B%22%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E4%BD%8D%E7%BD%AE%E5%B9%B6%E7%BB%98%E5%88%B6%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%22%5D%0A%20%20I%20--%3E%20J%0A%20%20J%20--%3E%20K%5B%22%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%9B%BE%E5%83%8F%22%5D%0A%20%20K%20--%3E%20L%5B%22%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%22%5D%0A%20%20L%20--%3E%20M%5B%22%E7%BB%93%E6%9D%9F%22%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Mermaid在线编辑器</a> 绘制示例代码的流程图，结果如下：</p>
